name: October
objective: Gift-led acquisition, 1M→6M upgrades and a Dhanteras annual window, without open codes.
strategy:
Festival of Lights.

Commercial job: Gift-led acquisition, 1M→6M upgrades and a Dhanteras annual window, without open codes.

Newcomer: Diwali Gifting, Minus the Dry-Fruit Box (“This Diwali, gift something they'll actually use.”). Gifting is real festive spend; the 3-for-2 gets recipients to the 3-visit mark that converts at 73–89%.

Upgrade: From Phuljhadi to Anaar (“Upgrade from a phuljhadi to an anaar.”). Upgrading lifts cash per member 2.3–4.4× and protects the base through November, the softest month.

Renewal: Gold Rush (Dhanteras Edition) (“Buy gold this Dhanteras. The kind that lifts.”). Dhanteras is India's 'buy something lasting' day; an annual fits. ≈24.5% effective sits under the annual cap.

Lapsed: Diwali Cleaning: Found Your Old Grip Socks? (“Diwali cleaning found your old grip socks. Sign?”). A physical prompt from the client's own home is a memorable trigger; the retail cost is low.
notes: Build: 108 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹12.0L; 118 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹27.6L; 53 winbacks = ₹6.0L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹4.5L. Offers carry ₹23.5L (47% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

funnel.dataQuality: lead→trial = CRM 'Trial Completed' status (not attendance-verified); trial→member = trailing measured; see dataGaps
